notes: All six pages read from Common Crawl captures; every .txt in each snapshot folder was read (12 snapshots), including older captures not listed in chunk-107.json (Warwick 20191022194539, Foster 20191018045729 and 20200922022733, Padua 20200927074829, USC 20200928032718, AUEB 20200927142617). No live copies exist in the folders. Institution strings copied from the chunk; note the chunk writes "Athens University of Business and Economics" while the page says "Athens University of Economics and Business". Warwick WRAP: the department listing holds one 1981 PhD thesis (Withers); the year is the thesis date in the repository record, recorded as yearMeaning "unstated". UW Foster: the job-market list is identical in the 2019, 2020 and 2021 captures (14 names, status "PhC", no year), so the page was evidently not updated; the integrator should not treat each snapshot date as a separate job-market year. Padua: the job-market page gives names and research interests only; no year, degree or placement. Email addresses on the page were deliberately not copied. USC Marshall: entries read "Field: Year" plus a school; the page calls them "a sample of Marshall's graduates" but never says whether the year is graduation or placement, so yearMeaning is "unstated". The 2021 capture drops Bryce Schonberger and Libby Weber and adds Roshni Raveendhran (Management: 2018) and Jue (Kate) Wang (Management: 2020). The string "Class of 2017" appears once next to the page title in both captures (apparently an image caption) and was not attached to any person. AUEB: the "Completed Phd Dissertations" table (Doctor | Dissertation Title | Year) is identical in both captures (33 rows); names are surname-first; the department is not named in the page text (site path "mbc", contact secretary.marketing@aueb.gr), so program is null. CityU Scholars: only page 1 of 8 (20 of 155 doctoral theses) was captured; names are surname plus initials; the year headings come from a list sorted by "Award year", recorded as yearMeaning "graduation" with the exact award date in note. No master's theses appear on this page.
